name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 3 visits over 51 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 27 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 28 hours starting 2025-05-09, at wavelengths from 1.12 to 4.42 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
